scope: online RL and RLinf UR5e inference share UR5eEnv
cadence: Schedule foreground target submissions / per-action forceMode calls within each chunk. Use local host clocks only. No catch-up after a missed period. Hold final target for one period before final observation.
state_sampling: Wait before preparing the next target using previous preparation cost, then gate submission to account for preparation jitter.
timing: target_interval_ms in RLinf logs / target_interval_sec in native JSONL measures foreground target submission intervals. action_interval_ms retains step-entry semantics; control_ms retains per-call processing plus pacing semantics and is no longer a full action period.
hardware: CPU and fake vendor SDKs; no physical robot execution

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=.:tests/unit_tests .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit_tests/test_real_env.py -k '(ur5e or native_ur or vla_precision or rlt_success_chunk or target_cadence) and not sync_worker_stops and not evaluation_can_close'
PYTHONPATH=.:tests/unit_tests .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/unit_tests/test_utils.py -k 'timing or structured_timing or run_logs'

notes: Broad -k ur also matched unrelated SO101 tests and was interrupted; the explicit UR selection above completed.
Training and pure inference frequency knobs are independent; their test no longer requires identical values.

followup_audit.frequency_scope: Same-chunk foreground updates: continuous true publishes a target; false submits per-action forceMode. Chunk boundaries and background PD cadence are separate.
followup_audit.overrun: control_overrun_sec now uses max(0, target_interval_sec - period); first target has no interval and overrun=0.
followup_audit.disabled: New diagnostic wait accumulations and target interval calculations are conditional on detailed/action timing. Local clocks and preparation cost used to schedule actions remain necessary control logic.
followup_audit.mode_controls: Online uses runner.timing_mode. Pure inference retains ur_evaluation.action_timing_enabled/save_logs or record.action_timing_enabled/save_logs; no shared three-mode interface was added.
followup_audit.regression: 106 UR real-env tests rerun after audit; see /tmp/cadence-audit-regression.log
